summary: Kashima Antlers 2026/27 home shirt (Nike): LIXIL across the chest, KANEKA on the right chest, mercari on the left chest above the emblem, NIPPON STEEL on the left sleeve, Yellow Hat above the back number, RISO at the back hem, SHOWA (Showa Sangyo) on the front-left of the shorts and 高砂熱学 (Takasago Thermal Engineering) on the shorts. The list is taken from the club's 2026/27 uniform announcement (2026-06-19) and the official store's uniform page, whose 26/27 OFFICIAL GAME KIT strip shows exactly these eight marks; the right sleeve carries the J.League champion Gold Badge, not a sponsor. The kit is complete against both pages.
